fact: CGA Technologies' project report, published April 2024, states that Wi De Ya is used to collect near real-time data on teacher and learner information and their daily attendance: head teachers complete a profile for each learner in the app and submit daily learner attendance, in the 300 primary schools it has been rolled out to so far (about 98,000 learner profiles, data from the third term of 2022/23), with the rollout to 1,500 and then 4,000 schools yet to be procured.
title: Wi De Ya, One Tablet Per School: Project Report 2022/23
